Open releasetrain.io

MLTL risk legend

  • Version row: a version document that satisfies the MLTL risk condition in the backend query.
  • Risk highlight (red background) marks versions where a risk flag is present (for example mltl.hasDiscussionWithinDelta or mltlRisk).
  • Channel chips show the release channel (major / minor / patch / other).
  • CVE chip appears only if at least one version in the component group has isCve = true. If you do not see a CVE chip, there is no CVE label in that group.
  • Classification chips show componentType, securityType and breakingType values when available.
  • Reddit sources under a version list the mltl.src URLs that contributed to the risk, each clickable.
  • The bar chart “Risky versions by component” uses the per component totals from the components array.
  • The remaining bar charts use aggregate.byChannel, aggregate.byComponentType, aggregate.bySecurityType and aggregate.byBreakingType.
